title: Hot Juicy Jamaican White Yam Skewers
description: A funky and juicy quick-fix Jamaican dish featuring white yam, miso-marinate, and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a snack or dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, soy sauce, brown sugar, scotch bonnet peppers, thyme, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the cubed white yam to the marinade and toss to coat evenly.
Thread the marinated white yam cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the white yam is tender and lightly charred.
Serve the hot juicy Jamaican white yam skewers immediately, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
